og.title: Infection Control in Child Care | CARSI
og.description: Childcare environments present unique infection control challenges. This course gives cleaning professionals the knowledge, protocols and practical skills to deliver compliant, effective infection control in childcare settings in Australia.

faq.q: Why do childcare settings need their own infection control course?
faq.a: Childcare environments present unique challenges: young children have immature immune systems, engage in high-contact behaviour, and share toys and surfaces continuously. They are also legally protected by strict regulatory requirements under the National Quality Framework.
Cleaning professionals who work in childcare settings in Australia and need to deliver infection control that is both compliant and effective.
The specific knowledge, protocols and practical skills needed to deliver compliant, effective infection control in Australian childcare settings.
